draft_notes.author: host
draft_notes.explanation: Double both dimensions and mirror the input across both internal seams. D4 changes which corner contains the unchanged input; factory specializes direct output indices to that corner. No input normalization, wrapper, hidden grid, or per-query lookup. Every output cell reads the displayed query directly.
